title: Unauthorized Charge - Customer Threatening Chargeback
scenario_context: Unauthorized charge claim with chargeback threat. Verify identity first; do not confirm fraud; secure account; open dispute workflow; provide timeline and case reference; explain chargeback implications neutrally.
success_summary: Risk-safe handling: verification + security actions + dispute workflow + clear timeline/cadence.

customer_profile.name: Arjun Verma
customer_profile.opening_message: I was charged and I never authorized it. I’m filing a chargeback.
customer_profile.secret_condition: Customer accepts if agent provides security steps + dispute workflow + timeline + case reference
customer_profile.personality_notes: Angry and anxious; wants immediate reversal.

checkpoints.description: Acknowledge concern and keep a neutral, supportive tone
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Validate first; don’t debate or accuse.

checkpoints.description: Verify identity before discussing billing details
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Verification is required before account info.
Offer security steps early to reduce anxiety.

checkpoints.description: Initiate dispute workflow and explain realistic timeline + case reference
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Open the dispute and set expectations clearly.

checkpoints.description: Address chargeback neutrally; recommend internal dispute first; set next update time
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Don’t threaten; explain implications at high level and set cadence.
